About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our platform team. You will design and implement scalable microservices, mentor junior engineers, and collaborate closely with product managers to ship features that delight our customers.

Responsibilities

Design, build, and maintain backend services using Go and Python
Participate in on-call rotation for production systems
Conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to teammates
Collaborate with the data science team on model deployment pipelines
Write technical documentation for new features and architecture decisions

Requirements

5+ years of professional software engineering experience
Strong proficiency in Go, Python, or similar backend languages
Experience with distributed systems and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure)
Excellent communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally
BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience

Nice to Have

Experience with Kubernetes and container orchestration
Prior experience in a high-growth startup environment
Contributions to open source projects

Benefits

Competitive salary and equity package
Fully remote work with flexible hours
Health, dental, and vision insurance
Home office stipend

About Our Company

We are a mission-driven organization dedicated to making financial services accessible to everyone. Since our founding in 2018, we have helped over two million customers manage their finances more effectively through our award-winning mobile app.

Equal Opportunity Employer

page: Marketing Coordinator Position

Sunrise Beverages is seeking a creative and detail-oriented Marketing Coordinator to support our growing brand team. This is an exciting opportunity to work on campaigns for our nationally distributed line of sparkling waters and juices.

What You'll Do

Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across digital and print channels
Coordinate with external agencies and vendors on creative assets
Manage social media content calendar and community engagement
Track campaign performance metrics and prepare monthly reports
Support trade show logistics and event coordination

What We're Looking For

2+ years of marketing or communications experience
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and social media management tools
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

Company Culture

Sunrise Beverages was founded on the belief that healthy drinks should also taste amazing. Our team is passionate about sustainability, and we source our ingredients from local farms whenever possible. We sponsor community 5K runs and donate a portion of proceeds to clean water initiatives.

Perks and Benefits

Free beverages stocked in the office daily
Summer Fridays with early office closure
Casual dress code
Professional development budget

Note: This job posting will remain active until the position is filled. We review applications on a rolling basis and will contact qualified candidates directly.

Explore More Opportunities

View all open positions at Sunrise Beverages by visiting our careers page. Sign up for job alerts to be notified when new roles matching your interests become available.

Connect with us on social media: Instagram @SunriseBeverages, LinkedIn Sunrise Beverages Inc, Twitter @SunriseBev

Sunrise Beverages is seeking a creative and detail-oriented Marketing Coordinator to support our growing brand team. This is an exciting opportunity to work on campaigns for our nationally distributed line of sparkling waters and juices.

Assist in the planning and execution of marketing campaigns across digital and print channels
Coordinate with external agencies and vendors on creative assets
Manage social media content calendar and community engagement
Track campaign performance metrics and prepare monthly reports
Support trade show logistics and event coordination

What We're Looking For

2+ years of marketing or communications experience
Excellent written and verbal communication skills
Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite and social media management tools
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment

Company Culture

Sunrise Beverages was founded on the belief that healthy drinks should also taste amazing. Our team is passionate about sustainability, and we source our ingredients from local farms whenever possible. We sponsor community 5K runs and donate a portion of proceeds to clean water initiatives.

Perks and Benefits

Free beverages stocked in the office daily
Summer Fridays with early office closure
Casual dress code
Professional development budget

page: Senior Backend Engineer
Acme Cloud Systems — Remote (US)

About the Role
We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our platform team. You will design and build scalable services that power our core product used by over 2 million customers worldwide.

What You'll Do
- Architect and implement distributed systems in Go and Python
- Own the reliability of critical payment processing pipelines
- Mentor junior engineers and review pull requests
- Collaborate with product managers to scope new features
- Participate in on-call rotation for production incidents

What We're Looking For
- 6+ years of backend software engineering experience
- Deep knowledge of distributed systems, databases, and caching
- Experience with Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure (AWS or GCP)
- Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent experience

Why Join Acme Cloud Systems
We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits, unlimited PTO, and a fully remote work culture. Our engineering team spans twelve countries and we pride ourselves on asynchronous, thoughtful collaboration.

Our Values
We believe in ownership, transparency, and continuous learning. Every engineer at Acme has the autonomy to propose and drive projects that matter.

Equal Opportunity Employer
Acme Cloud Systems is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, or disability status.

BrightWay Markets

Job Summary
BrightWay Markets is hiring a Retail Store Associate to support daily operations at our flagship Seattle store. This is a part-time position with flexible scheduling, ideal for students or anyone seeking supplemental income.

Responsibilities
- Greet customers and assist with product location
- Operate the point-of-sale register accurately
- Restock shelves and maintain store cleanliness
- Process returns and exchanges according to policy
- Assist with inventory counts weekly

Qualifications
- Must be at least 16 years old
- Prior retail experience preferred but not required
- Ability to stand for extended periods and lift up to 25 lbs
- Friendly, customer-first attitude
- Availability on weekends is a plus

Starting pay is $19.50/hour with opportunities for raises based on performance reviews. Employees receive a 20% discount on all store merchandise and access to a flexible scheduling app.

About BrightWay Markets
Founded in 1998, BrightWay Markets operates 42 grocery stores across the Pacific Northwest, focused on locally sourced produce and community partnerships.

Follow us on Instagram @brightwaymarkets for store updates and promotions.

prompt.raw:
page: Data Analyst, Marketing Insights
Northbridge Financial Group | Chicago, IL | Full-time

Posted 3 days ago · 214 applicants

About Northbridge
Northbridge Financial Group is a mid-sized asset management firm serving institutional clients across North America. Our Marketing Insights team turns raw campaign data into actionable strategy for the firm's leadership.

The Opportunity
As a Data Analyst on the Marketing Insights team, you'll partner closely with the marketing and growth teams to measure campaign performance, build dashboards, and surface trends that inform quarterly planning. You'll work primarily in SQL, Python, and Tableau.

Core Responsibilities
- Build and maintain automated reporting dashboards in Tableau
- Write complex SQL queries against our data warehouse
- Partner with stakeholders to define KPIs for new campaigns
- Present findings to senior leadership on a monthly basis
- Audit data pipelines for accuracy and completeness

Required Qualifications
- 3+ years of experience in a data analyst or similar role
- Proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (Python or R)
- Experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Looker
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in financial services or asset management
- Familiarity with Snowflake or BigQuery
- Master's degree in a quantitative field

Compensation
The base salary range for this role is $85,000–$105,000 annually, plus an annual performance bonus and full benefits package including 401(k) matching.

Life at Northbridge
Our Chicago office is located in the Loop with a hybrid schedule of three days in-office. We host quarterly team offsites and offer generous parental leave.

Share this job: LinkedIn | Twitter | Email

As a Data Analyst on the Marketing Insights team, you'll partner closely with the marketing and growth teams to measure campaign performance, build dashboards, and surface trends that inform quarterly planning. You'll work primarily in SQL, Python, and Tableau.

Core Responsibilities
- Build and maintain automated reporting dashboards in Tableau
- Write complex SQL queries against our data warehouse
- Partner with stakeholders to define KPIs for new campaigns
- Present findings to senior leadership on a monthly basis
- Audit data pipelines for accuracy and completeness

Required Qualifications
- 3+ years of experience in a data analyst or similar role
- Proficiency in SQL and at least one scripting language (Python or R)
- Experience with BI tools such as Tableau or Looker
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience in financial services or asset management
- Familiarity with Snowflake or BigQuery
- Master's degree in a quantitative field

Compensation
The base salary range for this role is $85,000–$105,000 annually, plus an annual performance bonus and full benefits package including 401(k) matching.

Life at Northbridge
Our Chicago office is located in the Loop with a hybrid schedule of three days in-office. We host quarterly team offsites and offer generous parental leave.

prompt.raw:
page: Sr Agentic Engineer — apply at FM
Flywheel Motion

We're hiring a Sr Agentic Engineer. This 40-minute task asks you to architect and ship a multi-step agentic workflow for one of our products, write a failure autopsy from your own experience, and sketch an agent architecture for a new feature.

Your name
Email
LinkedIn URL (optional)
City
Your actual city — not your work arrangement. "Remote" is not a valid answer here.
Country
Vietnam, India, United States, Nigeria, Philippines, Pakistan, Indonesia, United Kingdom, Germany, Spain, France, Italy, Portugal, Netherlands, Poland, Ukraine, Romania, Serbia, Croatia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, North Macedonia, Albania, Bulgaria, Greece, Czechia, Slovakia, Slovenia, Hungary, Moldova, Lithuania, Latvia, Estonia, Ireland, Austria, Belgium, Switzerland, Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, Turkey, Egypt, South Africa, Kenya, Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Ghana, Brazil, Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, Hong Kong, Taiwan, China, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Nepal, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Israel, Georgia, Armenia, Other
Your CV
PDF, DOC or DOCX, up to 5 MB. We ask for your CV up front so we can review your background alongside your answers. If your CV is in Drive or Dropbox, download it first and attach the file.
Hourly rate range (USD)
Your honest expectation, not the maximum you'd accept.
How did you hear about us? (optional)
Someone referred me, Wellfound, LinkedIn, Google / Search, Friend or colleague, Reddit, X / Twitter, Facebook, Telegram, WTF website, Other
Who referred you? (their name)
Website
Checkbox: Inform me about upcoming career opportunities at Flywheel Motion
